items.html: See regarding the Ibur ho ZA, how it is impossible to open the grave without blood when it is born. These are the parts called dross in relation to Atzilut. These dross and blood return to be sorted in Beria: That which is dross with respect to Beria returns to be sorted in Yetzira, etc., similarly in each degree. Afterwards, it is likewise with the worse in Yetzira, and after that with the worst of all in Assiya, also according to its degrees. This is so because all the parts of these three worlds BYA are female; there is no male among them at all. Even the males among them are but forces of the Nukva, since they are all soldiers and armies of Malchut, and all were made of the sorting of the seven kings, as we have mentioned.
